title: Agent Memory & Human-in-the-Loop
description: Design agent memory architectures, implement evaluation and monitoring, and build human-in-the-loop workflows for safe, auditable AI agents.
longDescription: Master agent production concerns: short-term, long-term, and episodic memory patterns in .NET; evaluating agent behavior with custom metrics; distributed tracing for agent decision chains; and human-in-the-loop workflows with approval gates, intervention, and audit trails.
whatYouLearn: Agent memory architectures: short-term, long-term, episodic
Agent evaluation metrics and monitoring dashboards
Distributed tracing for agent decision chains
Debugging agent execution and state transitions
